messages:
tara (marketing): Hey runtime team — quick ask for the webinar + press bench. Can we get a reproducible run and artifacts showing p95/p99 latency and cost-per-1M-tokens for gen + embedding for a few quantization configs? Need raw logs, a small trace for slides (waterfall/heatmap), and the exact run command + docker tag/git sha. Target for initial artifacts: EOD tomorrow.

matt (eng-runtime): Which model(s) and input profile do you want? sequence lengths, batch sizes, warmup? Also confirm we're allowed to surface raw timings in marketing materials (anonymized OK).

tara (marketing): Primary model: rw-13b-open (the one in the catalog). Context distribution: short (avg 128 tokens), medium (512), long (2k). Please test batch sizes 1, 4, 8. Streaming ON for generation runs. Warmup: 50 tokens. Quant variants: q4_0, q4_k_m, fp16. Need both gen (token-per-second latency) and embeddings (per-request latency). p95/p99 + cost estimate for 1M tokens. Also need the sample payload (prompt set) and the seed so we can reproduce exact outputs. :pray:

anya (data-science): I can hand over a vetted prompt cohort — already prepped v3 with 200 samples across the length buckets. S3: s3://redwood-marketing/webinar_cohort_v3 (read-only). Seed to use: 42. I'll also attach a CSV with grouping tags and expected token counts.

matt (eng-runtime): OK — thanks @anya. We'll schedule a run. Proposed run plan: do q4 variants tonight (low-priority GPU), fp16 tomorrow morning (higher mem). We'll produce: p95/p99 tables, per-batch latency histogram, and a 1-page waterfall trace for a representative sample. Output artifacts to s3://redwood-benchmarks/marketing/1778884321/ with checksums.

matt (eng-runtime): Repro command (example):
```bash
rerun-bench \
  --image=redwood/runtime:prod-20260317-rc3 \
  --git-sha=ab12cd34ef56 \
  --model=rw-13b-open \
  --inputs=s3://redwood-marketing/webinar_cohort_v3 \
  --seed=42 \
  --quant=[q4_0,q4_k_m,fp16] \
  --batches=[1,4,8] \
  --streaming=true \
  --warmup-tokens=50 \
  --out-prefix=s3://redwood-benchmarks/marketing/1778884321/
```
Please use that exact image tag and git sha in the artifact metadata. We'll also include a text file with the full launch env (CUDA, driver, cuDNN, pytorch, kernel).

kevin (marketing): Helpful — can we get a tiny CSV extract for the slide that shows p50/p95/p99 for each variant and a small heatmap PNG (timeline vs percentile)? If possible include a single-run flamegraph or waterfall for the long-context sample. That'll be perfect for the webinar slide. :thumbsup:

matt (eng-runtime): Yep. We'll output: artifacts.csv (p50/p95/p99, cost_est_per_1M_tokens), raw_logs.tar.gz (timed events per token), waterfall_long.png, heatmap_percentiles.png. Raw logs will be gzipped and include token arrival timestamps (UTC). ETA: q4 runs finish tonight ~ 11:30pm PT, fp16 by 9:00am PT tomorrow.

tara (marketing): Great — please also include the exact invocations and environment file in the S3 folder so we can link them in the press kit. And confirm the cost calc method (GPU-hours + token accounting). If the cost calc needs product input, loop in finance.

matt (eng-runtime): Will include cost_calc.txt with formula and inputs. We'll use: GPU_time * hourly_rate / tokens_served scaled to 1M tokens, include batch effect adjustment. If finance needs to sanity-check rates, tag them in the thread.

deploy-bot: GPU job 459812 queued for bench-run (q4 variants). ETA start: 2026-03-18T03:15:00Z. Status updates will post here.

tara (marketing): Awesome — thanks team. Please ping this thread with the S3 path once artifacts land. I may ask for a short rerun if the p99 behavior looks surprising. :raised_hands:
